_readme: USD per 1M tokens for Nebius Token Factory models. Nano and Super prices are taken from third-party trackers listing Nebius rates (OpenRouter, Bifrost, DeepInfra, Sep 2026), not yet verified against the Nebius console. Entries with "placeholder": true are NOT real prices; until filled, the budget uses placeholderFallback, a deliberately high estimate, so guardrails err toward refusing. Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 comes from a third-party listing (models.dev via mastra.ai, 2026-10-16), not verified in the Nebius console. nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL: the Nebius blog of 16 Oct 2026, "three new open-weight models from US companies", and the Token Factory model page (same rates as nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b). nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b (lowercase) is the free NVIDIA API (build.nvidia.com, decision 071), not Token Factory: 0 / 0, so its calls are ledgered at $0 with their real token counts; the Token Factory placeholder nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b is a different entry.
